QuestInfo.name: Phantom's Token of Heroism
QuestInfo.0: Gaston has a gift for you.
QuestInfo.1: Gaston has a gift for you.

0.0: Master. I sense that your abilities are once more developing to befit your title as a phantom thief.
0.1: You should be able to take care of yourself at this level, but I still can't help but be concerned. Therefore, I have something to give you.

no.0: Might I ask you to reconsider? It is, of course, your decision... but this should be of help to you in the future.

yes.0: There are countless foes who would oppose a phantom thief. I hope this will aid you against them.
